dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Irregular, jagged light-colored dendritic perimeters forming complex, high-contrast semi-closed loops; sharp gradient transition from high-intensity white/grey outlines to the low-intensity dark blue-grey interior of the pattern clusters.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low density of discrete punctate high-intensity pixels scattered along the dorsal ridge and clustered in small isolated groups near the anterior-lateral region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Geometric relationship defined by a primary triangle formed by the centroids of the large mid-body dendritic cluster, the neck-region cluster, and the posterior-most isolated white mark on the dorsal flank.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent, dark, elongated elliptical indentation/lesion with clearly defined recessed margins located on the dorsal aspect of the posterior peduncle just anterior to the flipper.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique map-like branching white patterns against a uniform dark background, displaying fractal-like edge complexity.
